newsitem.title: USA: Foamex raises tender offer for notes.
newsitem.headline: Foamex raises tender offer for notes.

text.p: Foamex International Inc said on Thursday that it has increased the tender price for $116.7 million in principal of the Foamex-JPS Automotive L.P. senior secured discount debentures due 2004.
Foamex said that it had increased the tender price from 86 percent of principal amount to 88 percent, resulting in an aggregate tender price and consent fee of 90 percent of principal.
Foamex's increased offer represents 118.8 percent of the projected accreted value as of June 9, 1997.

Foamex LP, Foamex's 99 percent owned subsidiary, began the tender offer on May 12, 1997, together with tender offers and concurrent consent solicitations for a total of $373 million of debt, the company said.
Expiration of the consent solicitations ends 1200 EDT May 27 and the tender offer expires on June 9, 1997, Foamex said.
Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities is acting as the dealer manager for the tender offers and the consent solicitations, Foamex said.
